name: University of Tokyo
summary: National university in Tokyo, founded 1877; its new English-taught College of Design opens in September 2027, half the places for IB-type applicants.

ib.text: Route B takes the IB Diploma with 38 of 42 points across six subjects plus at least 2 for TOK and EE expected; these are expectations, not cut-offs. Predicted grades work only if finals fall after the deadline.

apply.via: College of Design online application system

dates.label: Route B online interviews begin (30 minutes, one day in the window)
Final IB grades due for predicted-grade applicants

programmes.name: UTokyo College of Design
programmes.about: A single five-year programme combining a bachelor's and a master's, with all classes in English. Students build their own pathways across disciplines using design approaches, and take long internships in Japan or overseas.
programmes.ib: Needs TOEFL iBT above 80 or IELTS above 6.0 unless you had English-medium schooling for three of your last four school years.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review: essays, English video assignment, evaluation letter, then a 30-minute online interview. 100 places, 50 on Route B (international qualifications such as the IB).

notes: The page says the College of Design is under review by Japan's education ministry (MEXT) for approval and its plans may change.
Applying to the College of Design rules out UTokyo's other undergraduate entrances for April 2027, and you choose Route A (Japanese Common Test) or Route B, not both.
The FAQ gives today's admission fee (¥282,000); 2027 amounts come with the guidelines. PEAK and the Global Science Course (third-year transfer) are not routes in for a school-leaver.
